title: Pediatric Ovarian Tissue Banking - Operative Specimens From Females 0-18 Years of Age
official: Pediatric Ovarian Tissue Banking - Operative Specimens From Females 0-18 Years of Age
summary: A child is eligible to participate in this study because she is having surgery on her ovary. The investigators may obtain a sample of any discarded tissue from the surgery for an ovarian tissue library. This study is being conducted to understand how common ovarian conditions effect the number and quality of ovarian follicles and the reproductive potential of the ovary.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pre and Post Pubertal females
* Ages 0-18 years old
* Undergoing scheduled or emergent operative procedures involving the ovary

  1. oophorectomy (torsion, benign mass/cyst, malignant mass/cyst)
  2. ovarian cystectomy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant females
